description: Provenance, permissions, and local file hashes for the developer agent toolkit. Canonical skills live in .agents/skills/ and are mirrored to .claude/skills/ by scripts/sync_agent_skills.py. 'upstream.files' are SHA-256 of the exact reviewed upstream blobs at the pinned commit; 'local_files' are SHA-256 of the files in this repository (LF-normalised text).
install_method: Reviewed files vendored by hand from the pinned commits via the GitHub contents API (no skills.sh installer, no npx, no third-party script executed).

handoff.local_modifications: Output moved from the OS temp dir to git-ignored work/handoffs/; Git state recorded by scripts/agent_handoff.py; required sections; size and secret validation.

fix-ci.local_modifications: SKILL.md rewritten around scripts/ci_triage.py (run ids, failed-job-only logs, step list, exact SHA, redaction, untrusted-data fencing, no create-plan dependency); upstream script re-implemented rather than vendored because it downloads the whole run log once per failing check, has no redaction, and cannot take a run id.

reads: GitHub Actions run and job metadata and failed-job logs (via gh)
github_scopes: repo (read use only; the active gh token also has write scopes, so read-only is by script design, not by credential)
network: api.github.com via the gh CLI only

issue-to-pr.local_modifications: n/a (original thin wrapper over scripts/run_issue.py, docs/agents/briefs/, scripts/check_all.py)

reads: GitHub issue, newest comments, closing PR references (via gh)
writes: stage 2 only, after approval: work/agent-worktrees/*, work/agent-runs/*, branch issue/<selector>-<slug> (via scripts.run_issue)
network: api.github.com via the gh CLI only; stage 2 launches the user's own claude or codex CLI

grill-me.local_modifications: grilling method inlined into grill-me (no separate implicitly-invocable grilling skill, no cross-skill call); 1-3 questions per round; no sub-agents; explicitly read-only; optional local decision log.

writes: none by default; work/decisions/<slug>.md only if the user says yes

wayfinder.reason: Creates, assigns, labels, and closes tracker issues, pushes research branches, spawns sub-agents, and depends on unreviewed research and prototype skills plus domain-modeling (writes GLOSSARY.md and ADRs). Cannot be made local-only without a substantial fork. Replaced by grill-me plus docs/agents/templates/decision-log.md.

grilling.reason: Implicitly invocable by description; asks a whole frontier per round. Method inlined into grill-me instead of shipped as its own skill.

domain-modeling.reason: Only a wayfinder dependency; writes GLOSSARY.md and ADRs inline, overlapping the repository's own docs/adr conventions.

caveman.reviewed: mattpocock/skills history: added ab45d5e6 (2026-04-17), removed 7d3ada97 (2026-06-12); last text at 221ffca9
caveman.reason: Removed upstream with no stated reason or replacement; output-terseness only. Same-name repositories from other publishers are unverified and were not installed. Replaced by a concise-output guideline in AGENTS.md.
